market_question: Will New People (NL) gain the most seats in the next Russian parliamentary election?
reasoning: New People currently hold only 13 seats; in 2021 the Communists gained the most seats (+15). The Kremlin typically balances its managed opposition, and there is no clear signal that New People will be favored over others for the largest net gain. I estimate a 18% chance, well below the market's 28%, making 'No' undervalued.
evidence_points: New People won 13 seats in 2021, while the Communist Party gained 15, so even with favorable treatment they need a larger jump.
The Russian regime uses multiple proxy parties to simulate competition, likely distributing seat gains across several systemic parties.
No polls or insider reports suggest a dedicated plan to give New People the highest seat increase in 2026.
sources_consulted: General political analysis of Russian managed democracy
